works.title: Supreme Court Justices Political Novel
works.description: A fictional narrative featuring characters inspired by current U.S. Supreme Court justices, examining how institutional power insulates elites from moral accountability and shame fails as a deterrent for the powerful. The work explores the mechanics of systemic hypocrisy, institutional cowardice, and how complicity masquerades as judicial principle.
works.quote: I've been thinking about another project where I'd create characters loosely based on current Supreme Court justices and exaggerate their worst impulses.
